abstract.para: The &dlm.long; (&dlm;) in the kernel is the base component used by &gfs;, &clustermd;, and &clvm; (lvmlockd) to provide active-active storage at each respective layer.

section.title: Shared resources vs cluster resources
section.para: Clarify meaning of shared resources vs cluster resources

section.title: Protocols for &dlm; communication
section.para: To avoid single points of failure, redundant communication paths are important for &ha; clusters. This is also true for &dlm; communication. If network bonding (Link Aggregation Control Protocol, LACP) cannot be used for any reason, we highly recommend defining a redundant communication channel (a second ring) in &corosync;. For details, see xref linkend=pro-ha-installation-setup-channel2
&dlm; communicates through port 21064 using either the TCP or SCTP protocol, depending on the configuration in /etc/corosync/corosync.conf:

listitem.para: If rrp_mode is set to none (which means redundant ring configuration is disabled), &dlm; automatically uses TCP. However, without a redundant communication channel, &dlm; communication fails if the TCP link is down.

If rrp_mode is set to passive (which is the typical setting), and a second communication ring in /etc/corosync/corosync.conf is configured correctly, &dlm; automatically uses SCTP. In this case, &dlm; messaging has the redundancy capability provided by SCTP.

section.title: Group vs independent &dlm;
section.para: As &gfs;, &clustermd;, and &clvm; (lvmlockd) all use &dlm;, it is enough to configure one resource for &dlm;. As the &dlm; resource runs on all nodes in the cluster it is configured as a clone resource.
If you have a setup that includes both &gfs; and &clvm;, configuring one &dlm; resource for both &gfs; and &clvm; is enough. In this case, configure &dlm; using xref linkend=pro-dlm-resources

However, if you need to keep the resources that use &dlm; independent from one another (such as multiple &gfs; mount points), use separate colocation and order constraints instead of a group. In this case, configure &dlm; using xref linkend=pro-dlm-multiple-resources
